full_prompt_en: A square, crowded fantasy manga illustration places a young black-haired adventurer crouched on a mossy rock at the center. He wears a red scarf, sleeveless warm-brown top, blue trousers, wrist wraps, and a blue band across his forehead. His hands rest between his knees, and he looks forward with a confident, slightly mischievous expression. A huge blue dragon sweeps in from the upper right, its pale round eye, open toothy mouth, long snout, and horned head dominating the sky. Wisps of blue mane and curling clouds extend across the upper half. Around the central figure, several smaller companions and creatures occupy the rocky slope: an elderly white-bearded figure at left, a small pink round creature lower left, a pale-haired seated figure at right, and a wide-eyed small character near the lower right edge. Tiny airborne figures and fantasy shapes fill the distant upper left. The rock is mottled green, tan, and ocher, with tufts of grass and soft worn edges. Ink-like dark outlines keep faces and clothing readable amid the many overlapping forms. Watercolor-like washes of cream, dusty blue, sage, and warm brown soften the packed detail. Light is diffuse and high, picking out pale cloud edges, the dragon's blue scales, and the central face without hard cast shadows. The composition forms a pyramid around the crouched hero, while the dragon's head arches above as a dramatic counterweight. Fine hatching, expressive eyes, loose color stains, and miniature background action create a lively hand-drawn adventure rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、人物密集的幻想漫画插画把一位黑发少年冒险者蹲在中央苔石上。他围红围巾，穿暖褐色无袖上衣、蓝裤和护腕，额前系蓝色头带。双手放在两膝之间，带自信又略显淘气的表情望向前方。一条巨大蓝龙从右上扫入，浅色圆眼、张开的牙齿大口、长吻与有角头部占据天空。蓝色鬃毛般细丝和卷曲云朵伸过上半幅。中央人物周围，数名较小同伴与生物占据岩坡：左侧一位白须老人，左下小小粉色圆形生物，右侧一位浅发坐姿人物，右下边缘还有大眼小角色。左上远处塞有微小飞行人影和幻想形体。岩石斑驳呈绿、褐与赭色，有草丛和柔软磨旧边缘。墨线般深轮廓让面孔与衣服在许多相叠形体中仍清楚。奶油色、灰蓝、鼠尾草绿和暖褐色水彩般晕染软化繁密细节。光从高处漫散，挑出浅云边、龙的蓝鳞与中央面孔，没有硬投影。构图围着蹲伏少年形成金字塔，龙头从上方弯过，成为戏剧性对重。细排线、表情鲜明的眼睛、松散色渍和微缩背景动作产生活泼的手绘冒险节奏。
style_prompt_en: An energetic hand-drawn fantasy illustration layers many small outlined forms around a larger central color accent. Expressive ink-like contours and fine hatching keep the crowded composition legible, while watercolor-like washes soften cream, dusty blue, sage green, ocher, and warm red areas. A cool sweeping mass arcs across the upper region, countering a compact warm focal shape below. Tiny accents scatter into the background and fade through pale cloudlike gaps. Edges are sharper around the central cluster and more broken at the far perimeter. Diffuse high light brightens selected pale planes and cool highlights without strong cast shadow. Mossy stipples, loose pigment blooms, and scratchy marks make the surface tactile. The spatial rhythm is fast and layered, with overlapping diagonals, curving upper movement, and a grounded triangular center.
style_prompt_zh: 充满活力的手绘幻想插画把许多小小勾线形体围在较大的中央色彩重音周围。表情化墨线轮廓和细排线让拥挤构图可读，水彩般晕染则柔化奶油色、灰蓝、鼠尾草绿、赭色和暖红区域。冷色扫形弯过上部，对照下方紧凑暖色焦点。微小重音散入背景，并经过浅色云状缝隙逐渐淡去。中央簇群的边缘更锐利，远外围则更破碎。高处漫射光照亮选定浅色平面和冷色亮点，不形成强投影。苔点、松散颜料晕斑和刮痕笔线让表面可触。空间节奏迅速且层叠，由相交斜线、上部弯曲运动和稳定三角中心组成。
theme_en: A young adventurer and companions beneath a large blue dragon
theme_zh: 蓝色巨龙下的少年冒险者与伙伴
name: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
